articles.title: Wine groups AdVini, Cordier by Invivo strike assets-and-shares deal
articles.summary: As part of the agreement, AdVini will receive the Café de Paris sparkling wine brand and its production site, along with the Cordier brand.

articles.title: Wine groups Advini, Cordier by InVivo in merger talks
